title: Bench Operations Note for Repair Estimates & Appointments: Mounting Towed-In Vehicles
content:
**Note.** Mounting a vehicle that came in on a network-arranged tow, a tow-in charge having been posted on the booking, on the measuring bench adds a bench add-on to the Repair Estimates & Appointments measurement charge:

- such a vehicle with structural damage recorded on the booking adds **75.00 USD**;
- such a vehicle without recorded structural damage adds **40.00 USD**;
- any other vehicle adds none.

| Tow-in charge posted on the booking | Structural damage recorded on the booking | Bench add-on |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 75.00 USD |
| Yes | No | 40.00 USD |
| No | Yes or No | none |

The structural damage recorded on the booking is the profile reported at booking, as confirmed on the written estimate.

Hypothetical vehicles: a towed-in vehicle whose written estimate confirms structural damage — 75.00 USD; a towed-in vehicle with no structural damage recorded — 40.00 USD; a vehicle driven in — none, whatever its damage.
